$comment: What counts as an email address where none belongs, read by scripts/email-shape.mjs (the survey import and the seed bundle) and by the plugin's PHP (the Import screen). `pattern` is a regular expression without delimiters, matched without regard to case. A slash or colon can't sit beside the @, so "https://medium.com/@name.surname/post" isn't one. `teamEmail` is the whole of the one kind of email the site shows on purpose, a team work address, and `teamFields` lists the only places it may sit, each as its path of keys: the About page's team mailbox. The cases both languages must pass are in cases/email-shape.json.
